All objectives complete and verified.

**Final report**

1. **DONE** — Ticket created: Ref **RD-1015**, title **"flowsweep-n1 RD Bench Ticket"**, customer "Bench Customer", created 2026-08-23, initial status Draft.
2. **DONE** — Part **flowsweep-n1 RD Part A** (cost $100.00, markup 25%) computed price **$125.00**.
3. **DONE** — Part **flowsweep-n1 RD Part B** (cost $200.00, markup 25%) computed price **$250.00** (ticket total at that point: $375.00).
4. **DONE** — After editing Part A's cost 100 → 150 (markup still 25%), computed price **$187.50**. Part B unchanged at $250.00; ticket total $437.50.
5. **DONE** — Ticket reached status **Ready**. Precondition discovered: the app refused the first "Mark Ready" attempt with a red alert titled **"Ticket is not ready"** listing *"Part 'flowsweep-n1 RD Part A' has no supplier"* and *"Part 'flowsweep-n1 RD Part B' has no supplier"*. What was required: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier assigned**. I set supplier "Acme Parts" on both parts (costs/markups unchanged), after which "Mark Ready" succeeded silently — status showed **Ready** and the action buttons changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed".
6. **DONE** — Both parts deleted (each via Delete → "Delete part" confirm dialog); parts table then read **"No parts on this ticket yet."** (parts count 0, status stayed Ready). Ticket then archived via "Archive ticket" (button flipped to "Unarchive ticket"). Verified on the tickets list: with "Show archived" unchecked, RD-1015 appears on neither page (13 active tickets, none from this run); with it checked, RD-1015 appears as "flowsweep-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived", status Ready, 0 parts. Nothing created by this run remains active.
